learnings.finding: Four routes miss the24-unit upper-exit cross margin while staying in the actual48-unit full-hull stair band. Failure does not establish untraversable geometry.
learnings.scope: This strict retained protocol and these four Weft routes only.

learnings.finding: Four routes continue through grounded stair contacts with partial support at an outer edge; compile full footprint coverage separately from native ground contact.
learnings.scope: Exact compiled AABB support unions at recorded native frame ends; no subframe trajectory claim.

learnings.finding: All eight broad station results pass, but every complete ordered route fails. Two later low-speed pocket dwells do not erase their earlier failures.
learnings.scope: Nine16ms frame-end samples span128ms; fixed input only.

learnings.finding: The64-unit wall-to-first-riser gap leaves a32-unit deep clear stopping-center strip for a32-unit hull.
learnings.scope: Measured selected Weft stair bottoms, not a universal minimum dimension or recommendation.

learnings.finding: Fixed phase reversals produce different second-stair offsets. Validate gate meaning and test finite corner timing/braking profiles on unchanged geometry before changing architecture.
learnings.scope: Cause of direction-dependent differences is not isolated in this experiment.

next_test: Predeclare a gate-validity control and finite turn/braking profiles on unchanged geometry; separately measure full footprint support and bounded recovery. Retain this eight-failure record.
